capabilities: Fit Mermaid diagrams to page width during PDF and HTML export
Add horizontal scrolling for diagrams wider than the reading pane
Re-scan and rescale all Mermaid diagrams via commands
Switch settings language between English and Chinese
disambiguation: Not a diagram viewer or popup tool; it only keeps Mermaid diagrams visible in the pane and intact on PDF/HTML export.
extras: Works automatically after enabling and restarting; no network access or telemetry; supports desktop, mobile, and Slides views.
intentEvidence: It is useful for inspecting Mermaid diagrams inside Obsidian. Mermaid Export Fit focuses on a different pain point
motivation: The author saw large diagrams being clipped on PDF/HTML export even though they could be viewed inside Obsidian, and wanted export-aware fitting.
problem: Large Mermaid diagrams can be wider than the reading pane or PDF page, so the right side gets clipped in exported documents.

relations.evidence: Kudos to this plugin: Mermaid Popup. It is useful for inspecting Mermaid diagrams inside Obsidian.

summary: Mermaid rendering fixer that scales wide diagrams to fit and prevents clipping when exporting notes to PDF or HTML.
